subject: Executive intro — sponsor availability & split-shift proposal
messages:
From: Ava Standard <ava.standard@novapower.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Briggs <s.sam.briggs@novapower.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec intro & demo — availability for VP/CIO/CTO?

Hi Kimberly + Ben,

Thanks again for taking the time to connect with NovaPower. We had a productive discovery last week and the exec team has asked for a short, focused walkthrough next week to evaluate fit before we loop in procurement.

High-level ask: a 45-minute demo that includes a 20–25 minute product walkthrough + 20 minute Q&A targeted at our VP of Engineering and CIO (both want to be present). Our CTO is optional but may attend if schedule allows.

Two candidate windows on our side (Pacific time):
- Tue 3 Nov: 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed 4 Nov: 17:00–17:45 PT (EMEA-friendly)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can cover both (VP in the morning, CIO in the evening) or if you prefer a single combined slot? Also: are you able to record the session for our internal review and share the recording with procurement? I attached a short scope doc that outlines the topics the execs care about.

We appreciate a quick confirmation so I can hold time on leadership calendars.

Best,
Ava Standard
Head of Platform Strategy
NovaPower

Attachment: Novapower_Exec_Scope.pdf (1 page)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ava Standard <ava.standard@novapower.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Briggs <s.sam.briggs@novapower.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro & demo — availability for VP/CIO/CTO?

Hi Ava — thanks for the scope and the clear asks. Short answer: we can do a split approach to make sure both the VP and CIO get a high-signal walkthrough without crowding a single slot. Proposed plan:

- Morning (US-friendly): 09:00–09:45 PT — product walkthrough + targeted infra/cost discussion for VP of Engineering
- Evening (EMEA-friendly): 17:00–17:45 PT — architecture, compliance, and rollout Q&A for CIO

Logistics/questions:
- We can record both sessions; want to confirm NovaPower is ok with recordings being stored for 90 days (secure link) and shared with your procurement team. If you need longer retention, let us know and we can escalate.
- Would you like us to use the same deck both times or tailor a shortened VP-focused deck + a deeper technical deck for the CIO slot? I attached our one-pager and a suggested split agenda.

If that works, I’ll loop in Marissa and Ben to staff the two slots — Marissa can lead the morning walkthrough, Ben can take the evening Q&A (or swap if you prefer).

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_Demo_OnePager.pdf (1 page)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Standard <ava.standard@novapower.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Briggs <s.sam.briggs@novapower.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro & demo — availability for VP/CIO/CTO?

Thanks Kim — happy to run the morning slot. Confirming staff coverage:

- 3 Nov, 09:00–09:45 PT — Marissa Cole (morning walkthrough; product + cost economics)
- 4 Nov, 17:00–17:45 PT — Ben Carter (evening Q&A; architecture & deployment model)

A few quick asks so we prep the right level:
- Please confirm whether the VP wants a quick cost-per-call/unit economics slide (we can prepare a 1-slide snapshot).
- If the CTO plans to join either slot, can they flag any specific integration or security topics in advance? (helps us surface any SOC2 / retention / KMS notes up front).

I've iterated the agenda and attached a v2 that splits the deck into two tails (walkthrough + deep-dive). If you approve, Kimberly — can you send calendar invites (I'll accept and block prep time).

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Agenda_v2.pdf (2 pages)

From: Ava Standard <ava.standard@novapower.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Briggs <s.sam.briggs@novapower.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro & demo — availability for VP/CIO/CTO?

Kimberly, Marissa, Ben — this looks good, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming on our side:

- Morning slot (3 Nov 09:00–09:45 PT): VP of Engineering will attend. Please include the 1-slide cost snapshot.
- Evening slot (4 Nov 17:00–17:45 PT): CIO confirmed. CTO is tentative — we'll confirm by EOD Tue; if they join we'll send topics.

Recording: procurement is fine with a 90-day secure recording link for internal review. If you could add a short note in the invite about recording and data retention policy, that would be helpful.

Calendar: I held both times but will accept official invites. Can you send calendar invites with dial-in + Teams link (some of our execs use Teams)? Also: our legal asked whether Redwood can share a short MSA redline after the sessions — we can handle that through procurement if needed, no immediate action required.

Thanks again — look forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Ava
Head of Platform Strategy | NovaPower
